┌─ Help: The map and its legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Legend                                                                       │
│   @ you  m mob  M target  x dead  p player  r rare  * loot  ~ not yours      │
│   T trainer  $ vendor  B banker  H binder  g guard  Q quest person  & board  │
│   D door                                                                     │
│   ! new for you (gold)  ? hand in ready (gold)  ? in progress (grey)         │
│   gold m quest mob  gold D next door                                         │
│   c camp: where mobs are found (dim)  ░ zone edge: walking ends              │
│   ◄ ► ▲ ▼ the objective, off the map                                         │
│   % your marker  ; scout marker  v event spawn  G event goal  + plan end     │
│   Ground  # building  ^ rock  ≈ water  : ford  = bridge  " forest  · road  .…│
│                                                                              │
│ Marks and pointers                                                           │
│   A gold ! is somebody with something new for you; a gold ? is a hand-in     │
│   that is ready, a grey ? a quest in progress. A board that has something to │
│   take or hand in is gold. Mobs that count for a contract you hold are gold, │
│   and the next door on your way is a gold D. Shape says it as well as        │
│   colour.                                                                    │
│   When your objective is off the map an arrow at the edge points to it, with │
│   its name and distance (◄ Gorran 23m); the status line names it too. Nearby │
│ Page 2 of 7  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
